## Automated AI review > **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review. **Verified:** The parser change fixes the reported gap. `[bar] icon-slot`, `icon-canvas`, `icon-font` and `status-slot` set in a theme or user `shell.toml` now reach `Style.bar.*`. They follow the same parsing, fallback, `[font] base-size` scaling, `scale-with-font` and user-over-theme rules as `size-horizontal` and `size-vertical`. Configs that set none of these keys (no file, the stock template, size-only overrides) produce identical bar token values on base and head. `barOverrides` is read only by `barToken()`, which is called only with its six declared keys, so extra keys such as `background-alpha` are stored but unused. Bar tokens with a synthetic user `shell.toml` (defaults at `base-size` 12: iconSlot 27, iconCanvas 16, iconFont 13, statusSlot 21): | `[bar]` input | Base (iconSlot/iconCanvas/iconFont/statusSlot) | PR | |---|---|---| | `icon-slot = 34`, `icon-canvas = 22`, `icon-font = 24`, `status-slot = 26` | 27/16/13/21 (ignored) | 34/22/24/26 | | same, plus `[font] base-size = 18` | 41/24/20/32 | 51/33/36/39 | | theme `icon-font = 20`, user `icon-font = 15` | iconFont 13 | iconFont 15 | | keys removed again | defaults | defaults | | `icon-font = 0`, `-4`, `"big"` | 13 | 13 (fallback, same rules as the size keys) | ### Added test matches source text, not parser behavior The new assertion in `test/shell.d/bar-test.sh` requires the literal `key === "size-horizontal"` to be absent and an exact two-line `parseInt`/`barOut[key]` statement to be present. It fails on the base and passes on the head, but it does not check that any key reaches `barToken()`. Diagnostic in-memory variants of `Style.qml`: | Variant | New assertion | All six keys applied | |---|---|---| | PR as submitted | pass | yes | | Explicit six-key allowlist (the fix suggested in #11359) | fail | yes | | PR with `const b` instead of `var b` | fail | yes | | Allowlist of `size-vertical` only | pass | no | | PR parser, but `barToken()` ignores overrides | pass | no | **Impact:** Test-only. A regression of this bug written differently would still pass, and an equivalent refactor would fail. **Suggested change:** Evaluate the real functions instead of matching text: extract `barToken`, `boolToken` and `applyShellValues` from `Style.qml` into a `vm` context (the pattern `plugin-auth-boundary-test.sh` already uses), apply all six `bar.*` keys, and assert each `barToken()` result. A candidate of this shape failed on the base at `icon-slot` (expected 30, got 1), passed on the head, and classified all four variants above correctly.
Candidate assertion (replaces the new block in the run_node_test section) ```js const vm = require('vm') const styleSource = fs.readFileSync(root + '/shell/Commons/Style.qml', 'utf8') function qmlFunction(source, name) { const start = source.indexOf(`function ${name}(`) let depth = 0 for (let i = source.indexOf('{', start); start >= 0 && i < source.length; i++) { if (source[i] === '{') depth++ else if (source[i] === '}' && --depth === 0) return source.slice(start, i + 1) } throw new Error(`Style.qml has no function ${name}`) } const style = vm.createContext({}) vm.runInContext( ['barToken', 'boolToken', 'applyShellValues'].map(name => qmlFunction(styleSource, name)).join('\n') + '\nvar fontScale = 1, barScaleWithFont = true, barOverrides = {}', style ) style.applyShellValues({ 'bar.size-horizontal': '32', 'bar.size-vertical': '34', 'bar.icon-slot': '30', 'bar.icon-canvas': '20', 'bar.icon-font': '17', 'bar.status-slot': '25' }) for (const [key, value] of [['size-horizontal', 32], ['size-vertical', 34], ['icon-slot', 30], ['icon-canvas', 20], ['icon-font', 17], ['status-slot', 25]]) { assertEqual(style.barToken(key, 1), value, `[bar] ${key} in shell.toml reaches barToken()`) } ```
**Optional documentation note:** The four keys that now take effect are not described anywhere users look: the "Bar size" section of `docs/omarchy-shell.md`, the `[bar]` comments in `default/themed/shell.toml.tpl` and the `Style.qml` header cover only `size-horizontal` and `size-vertical`. A short entry for each (slot width, icon canvas, glyph size, status indicator slot; defaults 27/16/13/21 at `base-size` 12, scaled with the font unless `scale-with-font = false`) would make the fix discoverable without reading the source. --- ## Review information **Test scope:** Source review of head `d6fa34d` against `quattro` at `28ceaae`. The parser, token and `shell.toml` loading functions were copied verbatim from both snapshots into a synthetic harness object and run in an isolated Qt 6.11.2 QML engine (offscreen), with a V8 cross-check that agreed on every scenario. The JavaScript block of `bar-test.sh` ran under Deno on both snapshots. The real Quickshell singletons, the full test suite, the shell portions of `bar-test.sh` and live bar rendering at larger sizes were not exercised. **AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check. **Opt out:** To stop receiving these reviews, reply to this comment saying so.
